secure.title: Security & Compliance Posture
secure.subtitle: A public statement of how Numa is built, hosted, and operated to keep customer data safe.

intro.body: Numa is an enterprise AI platform operated by Arcanum AI Limited. This page summarises the security and compliance posture of the production Numa SaaS platform for prospective customers, existing customers, partners, and auditors. Specific evidence — reports, attestations, subprocessor lists — is available to qualified parties under non-disclosure terms on request.

cloudFoundation.title: 1. Cloud foundation
cloudFoundation.body: Numa runs on Amazon Web Services. The platform inherits the physical, environmental, and infrastructure controls covered by AWS's certifications (including SOC 1/2/3, ISO 27001, and PCI DSS). Numa is deployable in any AWS commercial region.

tenantIsolation.title: 2. Tenant isolation
tenantIsolation.body: Each customer is provisioned into a dedicated AWS environment. Compute, storage, identity, and data planes are separated at the account boundary, eliminating shared-tenant data co-mingling at the infrastructure layer.

authentication.title: 3. Authentication & access
authentication.body: User access is gated by managed identity with multi-factor authentication available, role-based access controls, and configurable session lifetimes. Administrative access by Arcanum AI personnel is authenticated, role-scoped, and logged.

dataProtection.title: 4. Data protection
dataProtection.body: Customer data is encrypted in transit using TLS 1.2 or higher and at rest using AWS-managed encryption keys. AI processing is performed via Amazon Bedrock; customer data is not used to train foundation models.

network.title: 5. Network
network.body: Public traffic is served exclusively over HTTPS behind a managed CDN with DDoS mitigation. APIs are fronted by an authenticated gateway that validates every request before it reaches application logic.

integrationSecurity.title: 6. Integration security
integrationSecurity.body: External SaaS integrations are mediated through an isolated, Arcanum-operated proxy. Credentials are scoped per user, never shared across tenants, and never stored in customer environments. Numa relies on AWS and a small number of selected processors; the full subprocessor list is available under NDA.

operationalSecurity.title: 7. Operational security
operationalSecurity.body: All infrastructure changes flow through automated, peer-reviewed deployment pipelines. Production access follows least-privilege principles with audit logging. Numa undergoes both continuous automated security assessment and periodic third-party penetration testing.

penTesting.footnote: Full reports are available to qualified parties under NDA.

dataResidency.title: 8. Data residency
dataResidency.body: Numa can be deployed in any AWS region. Current production deployments use US East (N. Virginia), Asia Pacific (Sydney), and Asia Pacific (Jakarta), selected per customer at onboarding. Customer data remains in the selected region. Other regions, including AWS Auckland, are available on request.

roadmap.title: 9. Roadmap
roadmap.body: SOC 2 attestation is in progress. Single sign-on via Microsoft Entra ID is in active development. Additional regional certifications and identity providers are added based on customer demand.

cta.title: Request the full security pack
cta.body: Detailed documentation — including the subprocessor list, penetration testing reports, and architecture briefings — is available to qualified parties under NDA.
